patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with dark backgrounds, often featuring large, impactful imagery or product UIs that span the full viewport width.
Dominant use of oversized, bold, sans-serif typography for headings and key statements, creating a strong visual hierarchy and immediate impact.
High-contrast color scheme featuring a deep dark background (black/near-black) paired with vibrant, almost neon, accent colors (pink, yellow, green, light blue) and stark white text.
Hero section elements (large text, main image, abstract graphic) dynamically transform and disappear or parallax as the user scrolls down, revealing the main content.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a guided scrolling experience.

Each product or brand within the Muse Group is introduced in its own distinct, full-width section, often with a unique visual treatment or product screenshot, but maintaining the overall dark theme and bold typography.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-driven animation (likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger or Locomotive Scroll) where the oversized headline text scales down and fades out, while the main subject image (guitarist) and the abstract colorful graphic parallax and shrink, eventually disappearing to reveal the subsequent content.
Content sections are revealed using a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they scroll into view, creating a dynamic and engaging content presentation.

The primary navigation bar is initially transparent and overlays the hero, then becomes sticky at the top, shrinking slightly and gaining a solid dark background as the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and some product UI cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, balanced and generous vertical spacing between full-bleed content sections, creating clear visual separation.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its bold, high-contrast aesthetic, combining a stark dark background with vibrant, almost neon, gradient accents and oversized, impactful typography. The dynamic, scroll-triggered hero transformation, where the main headline and imagery dramatically shrink and disappear, creates a memorable and engaging entry point that immediately sets it apart from typical marketing sites.
